acceptance_criteria: Committed independent negative seeds execute on required PR checks with a nonzero case count; bounded property tests record reproducible seeds/examples. Invalid lengths, counts, masks, duplicate fields, revisions and freshness inputs cannot produce TX or alter adopted state. Known-valid corpus inputs retain their independent expected results.
